bounds.max_steps: required positive interoperable integer bounding ordinary progress transitions, with two values reserved for the safety tail

progress.measure: ordinary progress transitions recorded in steps_used, separately from snapshot revision and the event trace
progress.safety_tail: one non-counted fault handoff plus at most one non-counted restoration; recovery_required rejects every other fresh event
progress.no_progress: rejected malformed or out-of-order events and exact replay do not consume max_steps, so the kernel alone does not bound caller invocations or guarantee termination
progress.generation_rule: a bound-material change requires generation + 1 and a generated, validated predecessor receipt hash

effects.ordering: commit snapshot/event record before executing returned effects

interrupts.restoration: permitted even when the ordinary step budget is exhausted

durability.reason: The engine promotion gates in module-decision.json have not been met.
durability.future_minimum: compare-and-swap snapshot plus transactional outbox and replay receipt
